name: 05-01-streaming-flicker-and-perf
title: Fix streaming-time turn unmount flicker and slow markdown morph in math-heavy sessions
description: Long math-heavy sessions exhibit two regressions during streaming: (1) the entire assistant reply (from start to current paragraph) flashes blank for one frame and reappears the next, repeatedly; (2) UI freezes for several seconds during streaming. Diagnosis traces both to virtualization windowing flipping at tool-call boundaries and to KaTeX-induced markdown morph fall-back. Plan documents minimal A+B patch on message-timeline plus a paragraph-level stable/tail split in markdown.tsx.
creator: claude-agent
notes: Reproducer session: ses_222c3a1f3ffeKdZxmCyui1E189 ("04-18-flavored-Schur-index续推至下一阶"), 149 messages / 2855 parts (2407 tool, 141 reasoning). Console evidence captured in PRD includes prevCan flip pattern, 200+ non-prefix morph warnings, slow measure took=101ms, and mount/cleanup churn for stable historical parts. Sibling task 04-16-04-16-message-jump-blank-page shares the windowing-instability structure but with a different trigger (session switch vs. tool-call boundary); fix patterns can be cross-referenced. User explicitly requested no immediate code changes – this task captures the plan only.
